# Eluxus Autoclean

> Eluxus (Eluxus Autoclean) is a mobile car wash business in Denmark specializing in
> steam-based car cleaning ("bilvask med damp"). We come to you — home, work, or
> wherever your car is parked — anywhere on Sjælland (Zealand), Denmark, with a focus
> on Copenhagen and the surrounding area.

## About

- Over 7 years of experience with professional car washing in Denmark
- Gentle, effective, and environmentally friendly steam cleaning — up to 95% less
  water use than traditional car washing, with biodegradable cleaning products
- Mobile service: we bring the equipment to the customer's address
- Serves private customers and businesses (company cars, lease cars, fleets, taxis)
- Open every day of the week, 06:00–23:00
- Pay only after the wash is complete

## Services and pricing (from)

- Udvendig vask (Exterior wash) — from 349 DKK: exterior steam wash, wheels, windows,
  door sills, finish
- Komplet bilvask (Complete car wash) — from 599 DKK: exterior wash plus full interior
  cleaning (vacuuming, panels, interior windows, surfaces)
- Premium bilpleje (Premium car care) — from 849 DKK: complete wash plus polish, wax
  protection, and extra detailing
- Retur leasebil (Lease car return wash) — fixed price from 1,499 DKK: thorough
  wash to prepare a lease car for handover

## Service area

Sjælland (Zealand), Denmark, with a focus on Copenhagen and Storkøbenhavn (Greater
Copenhagen). Addresses outside the core coverage area may carry a small surcharge.
